info.title: RedSecTools API
info.description: Repository-only OpenAPI documentation for RedSecTools. This file is not served by the live application. It documents the current HTTP API, including auth requirements for main app, guest-link, extension, and admin routes.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Main web app authentication and account management

tags.name: Homepage
tags.description: Homepage shortcuts and user homepage settings

tags.name: Vault
tags.description: Vaults, vault entries, sharing, and audit

tags.name: Chat
tags.description: Encrypted chat keys, conversations, and messages

UserSessionCookie.name: redsec_session
UserSessionCookie.description: Signed user session cookie for the main web app.

GuestSessionCookie.name: redsec_guest
GuestSessionCookie.description: Signed guest cookie created from /guest/{token}. Tool-scoped for paste or share.

AdminCookie.name: redsec_admin
AdminCookie.description: Signed admin session cookie for /admin/api routes.

ivPassword.description: Base64 12-byte IV used by the password re-encryption layer when hasPassword is true.

salt.description: Base64 16-byte PBKDF2 salt when hasPassword is true.

TooManyRequests.description: Rate limit or auth cooldown triggered

post.summary: Log in to the main web app
post.description: Authenticates a user with email and password. Depending on account state, this either creates a signed redsec_session cookie, starts MFA verification, or starts mandatory MFA setup.
Completes an MFA challenge using either a TOTP code or a recovery code. On success this creates the signed redsec_session cookie.

post.summary: Create MFA setup challenge during login
post.description: Used when MFA is required by policy but not yet configured for the user. Returns provisioning details and recovery codes for first-time setup.
Verifies the initial TOTP code for MFA setup during login and creates the user session cookie on success.
Clears the main user session cookie if present.

get.description: Returns whether the request currently has an active user session.

get.summary: Get SMTP availability for user-facing email actions

post.description: Creates a time-limited guest token for one tool. The token is redeemed later by visiting /guest/{token} and then consuming it on create.

post.description: Requires either a logged-in user session or a guest cookie issued for the paste tool.
Requires either a logged-in user session or a guest cookie issued for the share tool. Upload uses multipart/form-data with binary files and a metadata JSON string.
